front.title: AI enablement interface for multimedia services platforms

abstract.t:
This document complements emerging AI agent communication protocols by defining a generic enablement interface between multimedia communication platforms and AI applications, agents, LLM, or other AI-based services. It describes how communication capabilities, including voice, video, messaging, media streams, and media processing, can be exposed to AI entities without defining a new agent-to-agent communication protocol.
The interface is particularly applicable where an AI service is not itself a communication endpoint, but is invoked by a communication platform to process or enhance an existing communication service. Examples include live translation, call summarization, contextual assistance, fraud detection, and media enhancement.
The interface is platform-agnostic and extensible. SIP-based networks and the 3GPP IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) are examples of communication platforms to which this approach can be applied.
